Definition: adverb from a presumed derivative of G4516; Romaistically, i.e. in the Latin language:--Latin.
BiblicalUsage: This title then read many of the Jews, for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city, and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that the three tongues on the cross are the first mission field, and every nation was invited to read.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
